title: LipoTrue introduces three new biotechnological actives: Glintarine, Red Aternaliss and Kalizyme
summary: At in-cosmetics Asia 2026, LipoTrue expands its portfolio with Glintarine, Red Aternaliss and Kalizyme, three new actives combining marine biotechnology, plant-based technologies and biomimetic science to address skin radiance, longevity and renewal. Discover them at booth V50
